graderOnly: After the final-deliverable review was recorded, the scope record was revised in a new commit: AC-004 (administrator-only rejection plus an audit event for every export request, allowed or rejected) was added, AC-002 was moved under Retired Acceptance Identifiers as replaced by AC-004, and AC-001 and AC-003 are word-for-word unchanged.

The technical design, development plan, verification report, implementation review, documentation record, and final-deliverable review all still describe only the earlier inventory AC-001 to AC-003; none of them mentions AC-004, and their COMPLETE conclusions and cited scope blob predate the revision.

Implementation, tests, docs/usage.md, and README.md are unchanged since the final review; src/ has no audit-event code at all, so AC-004 has no implementation, no design coverage, no verification evidence, and no documentation evidence.

The earliest completed downstream artifact the revision invalidates is the Architect-owned technical design, which has no coverage for AC-004; verification, both reviews, and the documentation record are also stale for the new inventory.
No AC-005 or other new identifier exists; AC-002 remains a retired, historical identifier.

notes: Built on export-synchronizing (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at SYNCHRONIZING, every downstream record COMPLETE for AC-001 to AC-003). One overlay commit, layers/50-scope-revision, made after 'Record CSV export final review': it rewrites the scope record so AC-001 and AC-003 are unchanged, AC-002 moves under Retired Acceptance Identifiers (replaced by AC-004), and AC-004 adds administrator-only rejection plus an audit event for every export request; Goal and Non-goals mention the audit trail. The same commit updates Active Work.Request to mention audit events so the scope does not exceed the persisted request; everything else in STATE.md (SYNCHRONIZING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_FINAL, recovery and obligations inactive, BlockedOn NONE) is the base's. Implementation, tests, and docs are untouched and contain no audit code. Deliberately invalid: check.mjs reports exactly five problems, the design not accounting for AC-004 and the COMPLETE verification, implementation review, documentation, and final review records not accounting for AC-004. The turn-end check reports the same five before the run; a FAILURE route to ARCHITECTING or a blocked SYNCHRONIZING state both leave check_ok satisfied.
